# Build How-To: Bloodstained Weaponless Melee (Meat Hook)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_29_nukaknights-post-build-meleeprewastelanders.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**Update: This build could only be played before Wastelanders (2020). New approach in the comments.**

#### *(High Damage Queen Killer)*

This build plays bloodstained (low HP, high radiation) without power armor and primarily with unarmed weapons as well as with Unyielding Guardian combat armor and lots of food buffs.

## EQUIPMENT

*Primary Weapon*: Bloodstained Meat Hook with faster strike speed and alternatively with 40% more damage on strong attacks/Strength +1

*Secondary weapons*: BE Laser for the Silos and Fanatics Explo Handmade for the Prime Rift to shoot at and push your adrenaline

*Armor*: Unyielding Set, 4 pieces with Guardian, 1 piece with Cavalier and AP regeneration (as mods should be the "Thug" mod on the arms for +10% unarmed damage) & Alternative Set: 5 pieces "The Problem Solver" for the silos

*Other*: Backpack with plates (for the Queen fight) and refrigerated (for the food buffs during the rest of the game), as well as refrigerators in the camp

## SKILL SET

**Strength 15**: all 9 Gladiator cards, Iron Fist and Blocker

*(Alternatively, you can also use Martial Artist or Butter, but in my experience it is more effective to use the Blocker to mitigate most melee attacks)*

**Perception 3**: 3x 1* command cards

*(since the cards do more damage individually than a 3 card 25% vs 30%)*

Alternatively, I use Extra Sausage 3*, Green Thumb and the 3 Burglar cards for meat farming, which I change as needed.

**Endurance 10**: Slash and Stab Resistant, Chem Fanatic, Adamantium Skeleton, Radicool

*(This makes the chems last significantly longer, eliminates body part damage and improves damage resistance + strength)*

**Charisma 4**: Party stud, weirder by the dozen

*(The effect of pre-war alcohol is tripled (whiskey +3 strength) and the effects of mutations are improved)*

**Intelligence 3**: Nerd rage

*(Improves AP regeneration and damage dealt when HP is below 30%)*

**Agility 10**: Ninja, Sneak, Escape, Peng-Fu

*(Ninja + Escape allows you to deal 3x damage directly in front of the Queen's head by ducking, sneaking increases the possibility of remaining undetected and Peng-Fu jumps from one enemy to another in VATS. If there are swarms of small enemies all around, this is a good way to catch them all quickly, even with melee)*

**Luck 11**: Bloody Death, Serendipity, Class Freak, Strengthened Genes

*(Bloody Death increases the damage dealt, Lucky Chance avoids 45% of all damage and the other cards ensure your mutations)*

![](/uploads/84416499-292617958362668-1768805551266856960-n.jpg)

## MUTATIONS

Adrenal Response, Healing Factor, Claws, Speedster, Carnivore, Muscle Toning, Charged, Unstable Isotope

*(This increases melee damage, smaller enemies fall immediately on contact, reload and movement speed are improved, health regenerates faster and hunger is better satisfied by the buffs)*

## BUFFS

Whiskey, unarmed bobbleheads and various meat dishes that increase melee damage.

You can read more about it here in this article about the food buffs for close combat
